people.jesus.role: Son of the Father, whose teaching the elder urges readers to keep
people.jesus.relations: The elder calls him the Son of the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
people.jesus.meaning: The elder names grace, mercy, and peace from the Lord Jesus Christ. He warns of deceivers who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Anyone who stays in Christ’s teaching has both the Father and the Son.
sources.web.summary: The full text of Second John is the main text for the close readings.
sources.web.limits: The text gives the elder no personal name. Authorship, dates, Greek forms, manuscripts, and the audience’s situation were not checked independently. The lady’s identity was not checked either. The text names no house or city.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-49.summary: The lesson links staying in Christ’s teaching to resisting false teaching.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-49.limits: For Second John, the lesson covers verses 7–11. Linked reference entries and Restoration passages were not reviewed independently.
sources.usccb-2-john.summary: The introduction reads the chosen lady and her children as one Christian assembly.
sources.usccb-2-john.limits: This is the introduction’s own reading. Direct access returned 403. Proposals about the author, limits set by the papyrus, and dates were not checked independently. The false teaching, as scholars piece it together, was not checked either. The text names no woman and no city.
chapters.*.mapNote: Second John names no place, so the map shows none.
chapters.*.routeEvidence: The elder hopes to come and speak face to face. The letter names no route.
